reasoning: The icon consists solely of the letters 'PIN' inside a rectangular border rather than a pictorial symbol, making it hard to scan as an object at small sizes. While it directly represents a Personal Identification Number for banking, SIM cards, or smart locks, text-only badges are poor visual cues and easily clash with physical pins (pushpins, map pins, sewing pins) in keyword matching.
